", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“I can’t follow the play,” Francis whispered in Leoncia’s ear, “but just the same I hope here’s where we eat.”", "sha256": "051d94cfd87e59d9084a0b354b80871fcbb89cacaff8f3b9e92de5f0077954c9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1571]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Look at that pretty little girl,” said Leoncia, indicating with her eyes the child with the face of fire and spirit.", "sha256": "607535d18e7fa58e52291494d09d1205945717a9c99291892ef39ce26f783aa3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1572]", "source_html": "

She favored him with a long and unwavering look, in which they could see her think, and judge, and appraise. Then, with expressionless face, she bowed to him respectfully, and, with scarcely a glance at Francis, turned to Leoncia and favored her with a friendly smile that was an illumination.
